{"evidence":[{"sentence_id":0,"text":"The Transylvanian Hound (Hungarian: \"erdélyi kopó\" , also known as the Transylvanian Scent Hound or Hungarian Hound) is an ancient dog breed of Hungary, historically primarily used for hunting.","title":"Transylvanian Hound"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" It is a strong, medium-sized scent hound, characterized by a black body, with tan and sometimes white markings on the muzzle, chest and extremities, and distinctive tan eyebrow spots.","title":"Transylvanian Hound"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" It has a high-pitched bark for a dog of its size.","title":"Transylvanian Hound"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" The breed was rescued from extinction by focused breeding efforts in the late 20th century.","title":"Transylvanian Hound"},{"sentence_id":4,"text":" There were formerly two varieties, the long-legged and short-legged, developed for different kinds of hunting in the Middle Ages.","title":"Transylvanian Hound"},{"sentence_id":5,"text":" Only the long-legged strain survives.","title":"Transylvanian Hound"},{"sentence_id":0,"text":"The Boxer is a medium-sized, short-haired breed of dog, developed in Germany.","title":"Boxer (dog)"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" The coat is smooth and tight-fitting; colours are fawn or brindled, with or without white markings, and white.","title":"Boxer (dog)"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" Boxers are brachycephalic (they have broad, short skulls), have a square muzzle, mandibular prognathism (an underbite), very strong jaws, and a powerful bite ideal for hanging on to large prey.","title":"Boxer (dog)"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" The Boxer was bred from the Old English Bulldog and the now extinct Bullenbeisser which became extinct by crossbreeding rather than by a decadence of the breed.","title":"Boxer (dog)"},{"sentence_id":4,"text":" The purpose of the crossbreeding was the wish to eliminate the excessive white color of the breed, and the necessity of producing thousands of dogs for one of the most popular breeds in the world.","title":"Boxer (dog)"},{"sentence_id":5,"text":" The Boxer is part of the Molosser group.","title":"Boxer (dog)"},{"sentence_id":6,"text":" This group is a category of solidly built, large dog breeds that all descend from the same common ancestor, the large shepherd dog known as a Molossus.","title":"Boxer (dog)"},{"sentence_id":7,"text":" The Boxer is a member of the Working Group.","title":"Boxer (dog)"}],"peer_messages":["Unverified peer answer: noanswer"],"previous_answer":"noanswer","question":"Which breed of dog, Molossus or Artois Hound, is from ancient southern Europe?"}
